hook_text: 60 or 120? Every protractor gives you both. Here is how to choose.
clip_script: The most common error is reading the wrong scale. If an angle is clearly acute but you read 120 degrees, you have used the scale that starts at 180 on your arm. The cure is to estimate first: classify the angle, and the reading must agree. Sixty and 120 are on the same tick mark on opposite scales; only one of them matches an acute angle.
visual_style: A protractor over an acute angle; both 60 and 120 glow on the same tick; the 120 fades red and 60 turns green as the angle is labelled acute.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to measure reflex angles and name every angle type.
